# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes target the latest PlayWeld release and the `main` branch. Older
releases are not maintained separately; update to the latest release when a fix
is available.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report suspected vulnerabilities privately through
[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting form](https://github.com/scarecr0w12/PlayWeld/security/advisories/new).
Do not include vulnerability details, credentials, or private project data in a
public issue or pull request.

Include the affected PlayWeld version or commit, operating system, a description
of the impact, and the steps or a minimal example needed to reproduce the issue.
Remove real credentials and sensitive data from examples and logs.

The maintainer will use the private report to discuss reproduction, fixes, and
coordinated disclosure. This project does not promise a response or resolution
deadline.
